description: New features for user retention and production readiness: smart daily check-in prompt, weekly email-style digest, insights notifications panel, streak recovery, improved onboarding with sample data option, and error handling hardening
steps: In app.py - page_dashboard: Add a 'Daily Check-In' card at the very top (before the welcome banner) that appears once per day. It asks: 'How are you feeling right now?' with a simple emoji selector (5 options from great to terrible) and optional one-line note. Saves as a mood_checkin. If already checked in today, show 'You checked in today' with their selection. Use session_state + database to track.

In app.py - page_dashboard (or History): Add a 'Weekly Digest' section. When the user has 7+ days of entries, show a button 'Generate Weekly Digest'. This calls generate_narrative_summary with period='week' but frames it as a personal letter/email. Display in a card styled like a letter with greeting, body, and sign-off.

In app.py sidebar: Add a small notification badge/indicator. If the user has not journaled today, show a gentle nudge in the sidebar: 'Haven't written today yet - even a sentence counts.' If they have a 3+ day streak, show the streak count. If their last mood was very low, show 'Checking in - how are you today?'

In app.py - streak logic: Add 'streak recovery' - if the user missed exactly 1 day but journaled the day before and after, their streak is preserved (allow 1-day grace period). Update the _streak() function to implement this. Show a message: 'Streak saved! One missed day is fine.'

In app.py - page_onboarding: Add an optional 'Try with sample data' button at step 1 that pre-populates 5 sample journal entries (varied emotions, 5 different dates over the past week) so new users can immediately see what the dashboard/analysis looks like. Make it clear this is sample data they can delete.

In app.py: Add comprehensive try/except error handling around all AI calls (ai_analysis, ai_chat, ai_reflection_prompts, generate_session_summary, generate_narrative_summary, ai_distortion_analysis, ai_mood_forecast). Currently _call_gemini catches errors but returns error strings that get displayed raw. Instead, detect error returns (starts with 'Error:' or contains 'AI error') and show a user-friendly message with retry button.

In app.py - page_journal batch import: Add better progress feedback and a summary at the end showing emotions detected across all imported entries. Add validation that entries are not too short (min 10 chars each).

In requirements.txt: Add hashlib is stdlib so no change needed. Verify all imports are satisfied by current requirements.txt. The app uses: streamlit, plotly, pandas, numpy, google-generativeai. All are present.
In app.py: Fix the duplicate 'import sqlite3' at line ~4530 (already imported would cause no error but is messy). Remove it since database.py handles all DB operations.
acceptance_criteria: Daily check-in appears on dashboard, tracks once-per-day
Weekly digest generates and displays as a friendly letter
Sidebar shows contextual nudges based on journaling activity
Sample data option works in onboarding for new users
AI error responses show user-friendly messages with retry option
Batch import validates minimum entry length
All modules compile and import cleanly
verification: Run python -m py_compile app.py && python -m py_compile analyzer.py && python -m py_compile database.py
Run python -c "import app; print('Full app imports cleanly')"
Run python -c "from app import _streak; entries = [{'entry_date': '2025-01-05'}, {'entry_date': '2025-01-03'}, {'entry_date': '2025-01-02'}]; print('Streak with grace:', _streak(entries))"
